== Kobold Gem of Shadow Fade ==
[[File:Kobold Gem of Shadow Fade orb.png|right|alt=Kobold Gem of Shadow Fade, focus orb]]
[[File:Kobold Gem of Shadow Fade.png|right|alt=Kobold Gem of Shadow Fade, description]]
A gem empowered with the ability to grant [[invisibility]] and [[Evasion]] to all kobolds in a wide radius around the user. Note that the effect of this buff will be removed from a given kobold when he picks up a crystal.

Use this gem in a crystal collection [[challenge]] to give nearby [[Kobold Union Worker|kobold workers]] Buff Kobolds: Shadow Fade.

Acquired by:
* Killing monsters in the challenge, effectively [[Bound to Character]].
* Purchase from the [[DDOstore/Gear_and_Equipment#Challenge Tools|DDO Store]], [[Bound to Account]].

Usable in the following crystal collection challenges:
* {{Verified|'''[[Treasure of Crystal Cove]]'''}}

** [[Extraplanar Palace: Buying Time - EPIC| Buying Time - EPIC]]
